title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand — Episode7 Go Forth

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Event Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: Ryusuiso - Lobby

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is Shizuku gonna be okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She always shines in these situations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We should sit back and let her do her thing.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's see if Shizuku can get through to her...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Regarding your dream...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, I already said...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, just give me a moment to explain.
It's important.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your grandmother told me everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And she believes that you pursuing your real dream would be the happiest solution.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After hearing that, I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought that it's okay for you to be more honest about how you feel and what you want.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay for you to want to pursue your dream of supporting idols for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I know.
My grandma, mom and dad all want me to be happy more than anything else.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I have a responsibility.
I have to take over running this inn! Because if I don't...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I went through something very similar when I was still with Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, as you know, things didn't turn out so well for me back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There are multiple reasons as to why...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But one had to do with this compulsion to fulfill my responsibilities and not disappoint those around me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unlike those who truly love being idols and work hard every day because they don't want to be anything else, I ended up reaching my limit.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if you're going through what I did... If you're only doing this out of an overwhelming sense of responsibility, I want you to stop and take a step back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, you should ask yourself, “Is this really the path I want to go down?” and, “Will I truly be happy if I do?”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe you should have a discussion with those around you and take some time to think before reaching a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I live with regret, and I wonder if things might have turned out better had I made better decisions...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, you might be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I know what you're trying to say, Shizuku...
Or rather, I realize it now after hearing what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I do feel an overwhelming sense of responsibility to take over this inn and keep it running.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I know that if I only have that for motivation... Something will probably go wrong down the line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Even so, I can't let this inn go out of business.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I want to become your manager really...
I want to make my dream come true by supporting you and the others forever and ever.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But this inn means just as much to me.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It isn't precious to just me and my family. It also has a special place in the hearts of our guests.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What... What right do I have robbing this place from them by acting so childishly?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: That isn't acting childishly.
se_walk_women_004_2
se_walk_women_004_3

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Grandma...?! Mom...?!
Were you both listening just now...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, is that Saito's...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She seems really nice. Just like her mom.>

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Let me get this straight. Are you saying that it's “childish” for someone to want to pursue what they want?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
You're wrong about that.
You aren't being childish.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: We're talking about your dream here.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
So what?
That doesn't change anything. I'm still going to take over the inn...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: If you're feeling that conflicted, I can't let you take over.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: What Ms. Hinomori here just said is correct. You won't be able to run this place just because you feel compelled to and don't want to disappoint others.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: This inn succeeds only when you strive to do what's best for it and its guests. That feeling needs to be genuine.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But I do genuinely believe that!
I want what's best for both this inn and its guests!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
That's why I'm so torn!
I wouldn't be doing this right now if I didn't feel that way!

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: So you're “torn”? Does that mean you haven't been able to fully give up on your dream?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Ayaka.
Please stop robbing yourself of your dream.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but your grandmother explained to me what's been going on.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I feel terrible about us placing such high expectations on you. We didn't realize that it would lead to you being forced down this one path.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
But you should do what you want.
I don't want you to take over if it means giving up on your dream.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That doesn't make my choice any easier.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: If I don't take over, then this inn that so many people love is gonna disappear.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I... I don't want that to...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: This inn doesn't need to keep running if it takes robbing others of their happiness to do so.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
She's right.
Ryusuiso is meant to be a place that's meant to bring happiness to all.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
And not just the guests...
Everyone who works here, too. Including you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Including me...?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Plus, I'm not about to quit just yet, so there's no immediate need for anyone else to take over. We have time to start looking for someone.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: There's no rule saying that a family member has to take over. We can always see if we can hand it over to someone else.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Just so you know, we're not as shortsighted as you think we are.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: If you have a dream that you really want to pursue, then you should be doing everything you can to make it come true.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom, Grandma...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What a wonderful family...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You all care so deeply about one another...
That certainly explains why this inn feels so warm and welcoming. It's an expression of the Saito family's love and affection.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All that's left is for you to make your decision, Saito. But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you choose a path that you won't regret taking.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I... I just wanted to protect this inn...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But... If it doesn't have to be me... If I have the option of choosing my own path...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Then... I...
I want to help idols for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I want to put on events like the one where I met Shizuku for the first time. I want to put smiles on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom, Grandma, I'm really sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
Go...
However, now you've made your decision, you can't come crawling back. You shouldn't think of us as your safety net. We want you to commit to your dream.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But I think you have what it takes to make it come true, Ayaka. After all, you always put so much effort into the things you love most.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
You have our support.
Go after what will let you be yourself and shine.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness Saito changed her mind.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even now, I still wish that things could've gone better for me back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But, if I was able to convince Saito thanks to having gone through that experience, then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I think I've taken a step forward...)
